This app uses a bug in the kernel to load KernelSU. It is temporary: a restart puts the phone back the way it was.
It installs a small helper app as a system app, and that helper is what does the work. Home says which step the phone is on, one step at a time.
Nothing here is permanent. No bootloader is unlocked and nothing is re-signed, and the helper and this app\'s key come off again in the System UID section.
Root lasts one boot. After a restart, run it again to load KernelSU.
A run turns the screen off, because the display waking up is what most often kills the exploit. The result comes to the notification.
KernelSU\'s manager is for approving apps. Anything it offers to install permanently is not what this app does.
A run turns the screen off and keeps its log in the app, so the notification is where you see how it went.
Does this change the phone for good?
No. Root lasts until the next restart, and nothing on the phone is re-signed or unlocked.
Do I have to do it again after a restart?
Yes. KernelSU is loaded into the kernel afresh every boot, so run it again to get root back.
Why does a run fail sometimes?

The exploit races the kernel, so it does not always win. Try again, and restart the phone first if several runs in a row fail. If it keeps failing, the kernel check on Home says whether this phone can be rooted at all.
Why did the screen go off?
A run turns the screen off so nothing else wakes the phone up while the exploit runs. The result comes to the notification.
Why was a second app installed?
That is the helper, and it is the app that does the work as the phone\'s own system user. Removing it undoes the install.
What should I do once root works?
Open the KernelSU manager and approve the apps you want root for. Restart the phone when you are done.
How do I undo all of it?
Clean up in the System UID section removes the helper and this app\'s key. A restart clears the rest.
Which phones does this work on?
The ones the payload repository lists for this exact model and kernel. The app refuses anything else.
